## Load Library

```{r,message = F, warning=F}
set.seed(1234)
library(scran)
library(scuttle)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(Matrix)
library(SpaTM)

gtm_phi <- readRDS("./Manuscript/log_filter_raw_final_phi_output.rds")
```

```{r}
rm_samples <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/remove_samples.txt'
meta_df <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/patient_meta.csv'
ls_meta <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/LS_Meta.csv'

meta_df <- read.csv(meta_df,header = T,na.strings = "N/A")
rownames(meta_df) <- meta_df$Patient
ls_meta <- read.csv(ls_meta, header = T,na.strings = "N/A")

rm_samples <- colnames(read.csv(rm_samples))
meta_df <- meta_df[!rownames(meta_df) %in% rm_samples,]
meta_df$Cond <- NA
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CSU")] <- 'CSU'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"LS")] <- 'LS'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"N")] <- 'CTRL'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CTRL")] <- 'CTRL'
rownames(meta_df) <- str_replace(rownames(meta_df),"\\.","-")

meta_df$GCL <- NA
meta_df$GCL[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Subtype..HC..Generalized..Circumscribed..Linear.
meta_df$GCL[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Activity <- NA
meta_df$Activity[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Activity..Healthy..Inactive..Active.
meta_df$Activity[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Group <- NA
meta_df$Group[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Group..Fibrotic.Inflammatory.
meta_df$Group[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Cond[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'


meta_df <- meta_df[meta_df$Cond != 'CSU',]

meta_df <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-Patient)


#Summarized Experiment
bulk_counts <- read.csv("./Data/final_counts.csv")
rownames(bulk_counts) <- bulk_counts$Gene
bulk_counts <- bulk_counts[,-1]
bulk_counts <- as.matrix(bulk_counts)
colnames(bulk_counts) <- str_replace(colnames(bulk_counts),'\\.','-')
library(Matrix)
bulk_counts <- as(bulk_counts,'dgCMatrix')

bulk_counts <- bulk_counts[,rownames(meta_df)]
se <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = bulk_counts),
                           colData = meta_df)

keep.genes <- intersect(rownames(gtm_phi),rownames(se))
se <- se[keep.genes,]
gtm_phi <- gtm_phi[keep.genes,]
```

```{r}

##Infer
K <- ncol(gtm_phi)
se <- SingleCellTopicExperiment(se,K = K)

se_cts <- inferGEx(se,
                  num_threads = 6,
                  maxiter = 150,
                  verbal = TRUE,
                  phi = gtm_phi)

cts_out <- Matrix(0,nrow(se),K*ncol(se))
rownames(cts_out) <- rownames(se)
colnames(cts_out) <- unlist(lapply(colnames(se), function(sample) {
  paste(sample, colnames(gtm_phi), sep = "_")
}))

for (i in 1:ncol(se)){
  cur_gamma <- se_cts[[i]][[1]]
  cur_mtx <- se_cts[[i]][[2]]
  cur_sample <- colnames(se)[i]
  cur_cols <- which(str_detect(colnames(cts_out),cur_sample))
  cur_genes <- cur_mtx[,3]
  cts_out[cur_genes,cur_cols] <- sweep(cur_gamma, 1, cur_mtx[,1], "*")
}

saveRDS(cts_out,"./Manuscript/DESeq2/final_gex.rds")
```
